requirements.requirement: Definition, Campaign placement, live instance, playable conversion, and source-provenance identities remain distinguishable and are never silently collapsed.
Presentation profiles change information hierarchy only and do not create canonical object types or grant authority.
Same display name is never sufficient to merge Creature/NPC definitions, source variants, stages, forms, or conflicts.
An ordinary creature can foreground encounter statistics, Actions/traits, movement/senses, and ecology/Behavior without demoting Behavior to unstructured notes.
A named NPC can foreground identity/persona, relationships, motives, statements, reputation/faction context, and still expose combat mechanics when relevant.
Sentient creatures may use a hybrid presentation without inventing Campaign motives, relationships, factions, or persona facts from source sapience alone.

Authorization and field filtering occur before serialization and before suggestions, counts, facets, relationships, variant lists, compare targets, provenance labels, or derived summaries are computed.

Player projection excludes hidden existence, exact counts, reserve waves, secret motives, hidden relationships, unrevealed weaknesses/forms, GM tactics/notes, hidden inventory/loot, and unsafe diagnostics.
Assistant GM access is explicit delegation scope plus Campaign scope and expiry; it is never an unrestricted GM alias.
Administrative/Creator/Owner capability does not automatically grant Campaign-private or user-private Creature/NPC data.
NPC & Creature Manager edits Campaign-local authoring state through the owning workflow and does not silently rewrite source Definitions or linked rule objects.

requirements.requirement: Linked Abilities, Actions, Effects, Conditions, Items, Relationships, and Factions use stable references and bounded Inspectors instead of copied canonical mechanics where an owning object exists.
Scene quick-add uses constrained/provisional selection, revalidates current authority, creates a distinct placementId, and preserves source Definition immutability.
Placement-local quantity, visibility, label, encounter role, wave, starting state, and permitted overrides retain local provenance and do not become source facts.
Encounter preparation binds exact source/version/pack and placement assumptions, records inference/recommendation provenance, and keeps balance output advisory rather than guaranteed.
Launch/freeze produces an immutable participant snapshot for runtime; later runtime mutation does not retroactively rewrite source or encounter preparation assumptions.
Live HP/resources/Conditions/Effects/initiative/location/control state belongs to a distinct runtime instance and changes only through governed runtime actions/events.
Reconnect restores current authoritative instance/control/form/lifecycle state; stale cache cannot fabricate Events, permissions, expired summons, or hidden participants.
NPC profiles separate revealed statements/relationships/reputation from GM-private motive/reliability/faction truth and may represent uncertainty without leaking hidden truth existence/content.
Ecology/Behavior is first-class source content and Campaign-known bestiary knowledge can differ from GM/source truth without rewriting the source Definition.
Offline/cached bestiary can show previously authorized knowledge but cannot reveal new hidden source material while disconnected.
Equipment, carried inventory, loot/reward bundles, currency, ownership, and containers remain linked to owning Item/Inventory contracts, with hidden inventory/loot absent from Player-derived data.
Source-backed type/affinity modifiers can apply field effects without being forced into a new base identity; conditional source wording remains conditional.
Age/power stage chains preserve category-specific exceptions and do not imply every stage exists for every creature family.
Runtime form/transformation changes execute through the owning Ability/Action/Session workflow, change live authorized form state, and never rewrite the underlying Definition.
Comparison authorizes both sides before diffing, reports added/removed/changed/unknown/conflicted fields textually, and never silently selects a winner.
Summoner/master, controller, owner, source creator, Definition, placement, and live instance remain separate unless governed data explicitly equates roles.
Summon lifecycle tracks count/capacity, duration/resource limit, dismissal/destruction/release/control-break state and cannot resurrect expired instances from stale cache.
Creature-to-playable conversion uses an explicit source/base-version relationship and records retained, normalized, excluded, and unlockable elements without identity equivalence.
Monster runtime HP/conditions/state are not copied as Character current state; Character/species draft mutation belongs to the owning character workflow.
Dense stat presentation has one semantic linear reading order, keyboard section navigation, nonvisual linked-object/variant traversal, and no hover-only core function.
Resistance/vulnerability/Condition/validation/conflict/permission state never relies on color alone and comparison includes textual field-difference output.
Compact/high-zoom layouts preserve primary status/action, reflow to one semantic column or labeled records, and retain touch/focus requirements.
Authorized provenance-capable views distinguish source fact, source absence, recommendation/inference, conflict, validation, Campaign override, placement lineage, and runtime lineage.
Incomplete source records remain usable without fabricated replacement fields, and conflict/redaction behavior must not leak hidden object existence/cardinality.
Deep-link/history/draft/offline recovery restores identifiers and prior authorized state but reauthorizes before new delivery, target traversal, analysis, launch, or authoritative mutation.
